clue.text: They come with help — that's the best bit — but ease off

indicators.note: off suggests something gone wrong or out of order, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A grudging remark about sex: assistance is welcome for the best part, but then ease off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' asks for the letters of BEST BIT BUT EASE to be rearranged; 'that's the' just joins.
explanation.definitionFit: Babies conceived through IVF arrive with medical help in the laboratory, hence this cryptic description.

clue.text: Branch of tree with flower surrounding hideout for county

indicators.note: surrounding tells us the flower goes round the other pieces, which sit inside it

parts.note: a flower is something that flows, here a tide
the word hide with out signalling its letters jumbled
Staffs is the abbreviation for Staffordshire, an English county

explanation.surface: A botanical note about a branch and a flower round a hideaway in the shires.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hideout' hides its own anagram signal: 'out' scrambles 'hide'. 'Flower' is the old crossword trick for something that flows, not a bloom; 'with' and 'for' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: On a family tree the female line of descent is called this, a branch of the family.

clue.text: 5 shortly taking in fool

indicators.note: taking in means the first word swallows the second, holding it inside

parts.note: shortly means soon
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A barber soon to admit an idiot.
explanation.walkthrough: '5' refers to the answer at 5-down, BARBER; Vidal Sassoon was the famous London hairdresser.
explanation.definitionFit: Vidal Sassoon was a celebrated hairdresser, so his name stands for a member of the trade.

clue.text: Time to bring up covering for certain person of account

indicators.note: covering means the first word wraps around the second like a cover

parts.note: to rear a child is to bring it up
certain means sure

explanation.surface: Time to raise a lid over a particular accountant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'certain person' looks like one phrase, but 'certain' is wordplay and 'for' only joins; the definition is 'person of account'.
explanation.definitionFit: A treasurer keeps the accounts of a club or society, so is a person responsible for them.

clue.text: Mad about diamonds and squares

indicators.note: about means going round, so the word for mad encloses the card suit letter

parts.note: bananas is slang for mad
D is the abbreviation for diamonds in card games

explanation.surface: Crazy about jewels and geometric shapes.
explanation.definitionFit: Bandanas are square scarves, so squares is a loose synonym for them as pieces of cloth.

clue.text: Top worker with musical shop …

definitions.meaning: the top is the head, and this worker cuts hair on it
add shop and you get a close-harmony style of singing, as in a quartet

explanation.definitionFit: A barber works on the top of the head, and barbershop is a style of close-harmony singing.

clue.text: … originally attending to beast, died

definitions.note: continuing from 5-down: the trade's name came from Latin for the thing it first tended

parts.note: a bear is a beast
D is the abbreviation for died in genealogy

explanation.surface: A tale continued: a barber's shop where someone was tending an animal that died.
explanation.walkthrough: The ellipsis joins this to 5-down: a BARBER, from Latin barba, was originally one attending to this. Read alone the definition is incomplete.
explanation.definitionFit: The word barber derives from the Latin barba, so the trade originally tended facial hair.

clue.text: Old player that takes penalties?

parts.note: ex means former, old
an actor is a player on stage

explanation.surface: A veteran footballer who steps up for spot kicks.
explanation.walkthrough: The football surface misleads: the definition means one who demands penalties or payments.
explanation.definitionFit: An exactor is one who exacts, that is demands payment or penalties from others.

clue.text: Chinese lady of the Golden River supplies sour spermaceti

definitions.text: Chinese lady of the Golden River

indicators.note: read as the adverb of supple, flexibly, so the letters are bent into a new order

explanation.surface: A Chinese woman from a famous river providing whale oil that has gone off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supplies' is read as 'supplely', bendily, an anagram signal for SOUR SPERMACETI. Lady Precious Stream is a traditional Chinese play.
explanation.definitionFit: Lady Precious Stream is the heroine of a traditional Chinese play adapted for the English stage.

clue.text: Oriental feast attended by new queen

parts.note: Easter is a Christian feast
ER, Elizabeth Regina, stands for the Queen

explanation.surface: An Eastern festival attended by a newly crowned monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone from the East, an Oriental, is a native of the eastern lands.

clue.text: Red Robin's commercial tune

parts.note: an ad is a commercial
an air is a tune

explanation.surface: A robin redbreast's song used in an advertisement.
explanation.walkthrough: Red Adair was a famous oil-well firefighter and Robin Adair is an old song; the definition is the surname they share.
explanation.definitionFit: The surname shared by firefighter Red Adair and the subject of the song Robin Adair.

clue.text: Jeremy's chains

definitions.meaning: the surname of the actor Jeremy, star of Brideshead Revisited

explanation.definitionFit: Jeremy Irons is the actor, and irons are fetters, chains for a prisoner.

clue.text: Relating to story of terrible accident without oxygen

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the jumbled letters go round the gas symbol
terrible suggests something wrecked, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: Telling the tale of a dreadful crash with no air supply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terrible' rearranges ACCIDENT to ANECDTIC, and 'without' (outside) puts that round O.
explanation.definitionFit: Anecdotic describes something told as an anecdote, a short story.

clue.text: A number of golds for a like number in the band

parts.note: ten is a number
or is gold in heraldry, so golds are ORS
X is ten in Roman numerals, the same number as before

explanation.surface: Ten gold medals in exchange for ten more somewhere in the group.
explanation.walkthrough: OR is the heraldic word for gold; X matches the earlier TEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenor saxophone is an instrument played in a jazz or dance band.

clue.text: Beginning and end of months, not the end for most solvers

indicators.note: not the end tells us to drop a final letter E from the piece

parts.note: September, November and December all end in -ember

indicators.note: most means all but the last letter

parts.note: solvers are you, the people reading the puzzle

explanation.surface: Start and finish of the month, not the last step for most crossword fans.
explanation.walkthrough: EMBER loses its last E ('not the end') to give EMBR; 'most' of YOU is YO. 'for' is a spare link.
explanation.definitionFit: An embryo is the earliest stage of an organism, so a beginning of life.

clue.text: Kummel's no different from honeydew

indicators.note: different means the letters are made into something else

explanation.surface: The liqueur is no different from a sweet melon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'different' rearranges KUMMELS NO; Kummel is a caraway liqueur.
explanation.definitionFit: A honeydew is a variety of muskmelon, a sweet melon with pale flesh.

clue.text: Look left to take in almost nude and very wriggly creature

indicators.note: to take in means the first word holds the second inside it

parts.note: to look is to see

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: nude means naked

explanation.surface: Look to the left and you see something nearly naked squirming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to take in' and 'almost' are the indicators; 'and' is a link. 'very wriggly' is fair because the creature is both a snake and an eel by name.
explanation.definitionFit: A snake eel is a long eel resembling a snake, doubly wriggly.

clue.text: Musical 5 a cipher, say?

indicators.note: say signals that we go by how the words are spoken

parts.note: a cipher is a zero, a figure O

explanation.surface: A question about whether a musical barber is a nonentity.
explanation.walkthrough: A cipher is a nought, 'figure O', which spoken sounds like the barber's name. '5' is BARBER.
explanation.definitionFit: Figaro is the barber of Seville in Rossini's opera and in Mozart's follow-up.

clue.text: Land of courage or giant-killing

indicators.note: of means the answer is drawn out of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A country known for bravery or for felling giants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of' points to the answer running through cou-RAGE OR GIA-nt.
explanation.definitionFit: Georgia is a country in the Caucasus, as well as a US state.

clue.text: See 22
21's 5 who treated head ill

indicators.note: treated suggests something processed or altered, so these letters change order

explanation.surface: A barber who tended a man's head when it was poorly.
explanation.walkthrough: In the Bible Delilah had Samson's hair cut, making her his barber.
explanation.definitionFit: Delilah had Samson's hair cut off, so she acted as the strongman's barber.

clue.text: This strong man at first must drop 11 old pence if wanting fruit

indicators.note: at first points to the opening letter as the one to change
a shilling was twelve pence, so dropping eleven leaves one penny

parts.note: a damson is a plum-like fruit

explanation.surface: The biblical strongman starts losing money if he wants a plum.
explanation.walkthrough: In old money S (shilling) was 12d; drop 11 and you have D (penny). So changing the first S to D turns the answer into a fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: Samson was the biblical hero of great strength.

clue.text: Military 5's work sees Clare returned with Sidney in range

parts.note: Clare Short was a British Labour politician
back means returned

indicators.note: in means the name goes inside the mountain range

parts.note: the Andes is a mountain range
Sid is short for Sidney

explanation.surface: A politician turns up with Sid amid the mountains to admire a soldier's haircut.
explanation.walkthrough: Clare Short was a Labour cabinet minister. The classic military haircut is the work of a barber (5).
explanation.definitionFit: A short back and sides is the classic army haircut, a barber's work.

clue.text: Everyone expressing a lot of mild disapproval

indicators.note: a lot of means most but not all, so the final letters go

parts.note: with expressing before it, voicing mild disapproval is tutting

explanation.surface: Everybody clicking their tongues.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expressing ... mild disapproval' is TUTTING, and 'a lot of' it drops the last two letters. Tutti is the musical direction for all to play.
explanation.definitionFit: Tutti is Italian for all, used in music when everyone plays together.

clue.text: Fine beast losing tail gets caught

indicators.note: losing tail means the last letter is removed

parts.note: a mule is a beast of burden
CT is a scorecard abbreviation for caught in cricket

explanation.surface: An animal with a docked tail is captured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fine' is a verb here: to mulct is to fine.
explanation.definitionFit: To mulct someone is to fine them or extract money from them as a penalty.

clue.text: One of our 20 shows what to do with virgin soil

definitions.meaning: we have twenty fingers and toes in all

definitions.text: shows what to do with virgin soil
definitions.meaning: an instruction to turn over untilled earth with a spade

explanation.definitionFit: A digit is a finger or toe, and dig it is what you do to untilled earth.

clue.text: Lib Dem peer with Tory colour

parts.note: David Steel, former Liberal leader, sits in the Lords as a Liberal Democrat
blue is the colour of the Conservatives, so a Tory is a blue

explanation.surface: A Liberal Democrat lord joins the Conservatives' camp.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a Tory is a member of the Conservative party, whose colour is blue.
explanation.definitionFit: Steel blue is a dark greyish-blue shade, a colour.

clue.text: Sodium and thulium includes sodium in opera and song

parts.note: NA is the chemical symbol for sodium

indicators.note: includes means the chemical symbol wraps around what follows

parts.note: TM is the chemical symbol for thulium

indicators.note: in means the second sodium symbol goes inside the opera

parts.note: Iolanthe is a Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera
NA is the chemical symbol for sodium

explanation.surface: A chemistry formula set inside an opera and a tune.
explanation.walkthrough: Iolanthe is a Gilbert and Sullivan comic opera; 'includes' and 'in' nest the pieces, and 'and' links.
explanation.definitionFit: A national anthem is a country's official patriotic song.
